Talent0_2Ability.name: Diligent
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When failing to land a critical hit, gains <buf ID=3002502>[Focus I]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks. This effect lasts until a critical hit is landed.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Diligent
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: When failing to land a critical hit, gains <buf ID=3002512>[Focus II]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. This effect lasts until a critical hit is landed.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: After destroying the target, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

300202.name: Intuitive Fire
300202.describe: Uses Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> DMG. Cannot access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode before combat.

300203.name: Weakening
300203.SpecificEffects: If the attack hits the target, inflict <buf ID=7101201>[DMG Down I]</buf> after combat, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

700029.name: Arm Repair
700029.describe: Restore <color=#F74848>30%</color> of HP. Can repair the damaged Arm.

700021.name: Range Suppression
700021.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile the target is farther away, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

300206.name: Final Test
300206.describe: Uses Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. Before combat, access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode and gain <buf ID=7100401>[Crit Rate UP I]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: [Sniper Warfare 1] can trigger after destroying a part.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering [Sniper Warfare 1]'s <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When destroying a part, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300031.name: Forbidden Zone 1
300031.SpecificEffects: Before enemies within range initiate combat, triggers <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> with a Ranged Weapon, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2
300034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
300036.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> targets the part with the lowest HP, inflicting DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>-35%</color> on the target hit until the end of this attack.

hiddenSkills.name: Accurate Fire
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking and gains Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.
